# BachelorPad+ Lite -- help

*Generated from `docs/` by `scripts/Build-AppHelp.ps1`. Do not edit.*

Notepad when you want it. More when you need it.

This is the help that ships with the program. It is Markdown, and you are
reading it in the editor it describes -- there is no browser involved,
because this product launches no programs (ADR-0057).

The full manual, including how to build and contribute, is at
<https://bpad.prompt-forge.dev/docs>.
